  aspect-status-downgrade
            Aspect 'header-comment': node type 'service' in yg-architecture.yaml declares status 'advisory', but the aspect already reaches the 4 nodes it attaches to there (app/svc-01, app/svc-02, app/svc-03, …) as 'enforced' from the aspect default (enforced, because the aspect's yg-aspect.yaml sets no status:).
            Why: An explicit attach-site status cannot relax (downgrade) what already cascades — that would silently weaken enforcement. An attach site can only raise the status above the aspect default and the other sites, never lower it.
            Fix: Remove the explicit status from node type 'service' in yg-architecture.yaml (let the cascade win), or, to weaken the rule everywhere, set a lower status: in the aspect's yg-aspect.yaml. See: yg knowledge read aspect-status.
